brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1600x900 or 1536x864 PNG, minimum width 1000px.
Article facts and permitted headline content: the supplied frozen article says Nagoya Diamond Dolphins beat Toyama 93–80 on November 7, 2026, reaching 11 consecutive wins from the season opener; next game is November 9 against Gunma. Do not add facts or consult other article versions.
Design: approved bold black-and-lime sports ink style. Near-black #151A18 background, acid-lime #CCF43B expressive brush streaks, ivory white oversized Japanese typography, hand-drawn ink hatching, dry brush edges, sparse energetic composition. The large headline occupies the left 57%; an athletic action illustration occupies the right 43%. Large lime 11 is the numerical focal point, with 開幕 and 連勝 legible beside it. Plenty of negative space behind text; keep all text comfortably within 60px safe margins. No gradients, no photography, no 3D, no glossy effects.
Person: depict the real named player TAKUMI SAITO / 齋藤拓実 only, a lean Japanese male point guard. This is the article's most individually developed player: it reports his points and assists and the head coach's praise. Appearance was visually checked from his current official Nagoya Diamond Dolphins roster portrait at https://nagoya-dolphins.jp/team/players/detail/id=14611 and its official photo https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026102608/files/user/roster/729/2026-27/14301_01.jpg . Likeness details: straight black hair forming a soft rounded bowl shape, tapered sides, long lightly separated fringe almost to eyebrows; clean-shaven face, long slim oval face narrowing to a small rounded chin, straight modest nose, narrow almond-shaped dark eyes, fairly straight brows, thin relaxed lips, visible ears; compact lean muscular shoulders. Preserve those distinct features in drawn ink rather than generic anime facial features. Use black, ivory and subtle gray hatching for the person, with a simple light-colored sleeveless basketball uniform. Jersey entirely blank: no logos, team mark, sponsors, names or numbers. No official photo collage, no recreation of the portrait pose.
Action and framing: dynamic three-quarter low drive with a basketball controlled by one hand, torso leaning forward, free arm bent naturally for balance, head looking upcourt to the left; face prominent and recognizable. Show the whole head, shoulders, elbows and both hands without clipping; legs may end at a deliberate lower-thigh crop. Correct human anatomy, five fingers per hand where visible, believable wrist and ball contact. Ball is a small orange prop held/controlled by the real player, not the main subject. Background only abstract diagonal lime speed brushes; no additional people, mascot, arena specifics or scoreboard. This is a conceptual illustration, not any particular documented play, not a decisive shot or actual game recreation.
Exact visible Japanese text only, no other text:
Top left small: 「バスケまとめ」 and 「2026.11.08」
Main headline: 「名古屋D」
Main headline below, very large: 「開幕11連勝」
Supporting line below main: 「次戦 11/9 群馬」
Bottom left readable footer: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Immediately beneath or beside footer: 「成績をもとにしたイメージ」
Make the kanji and digits accurate. Do not include the player's name or any personal statistics. Do not introduce an overall league record claim. Keep 11/9 explicitly prefixed 次戦 to avoid suggesting that match has happened. No team or league logo, watermarks, badges, sponsor lettering, English slogans or extra numbers. Output only one finished thumbnail.
